heard: This colossal galaxy spans about 16 million light years across. Are Milky Ways just a spec in comparison? 100 Milky Ways laid end-to-end barely match it. Astronomers name this monster Alcyonix after a Greek giant. A supermassive black hole shoots plasma jets out from its center. Scientists were shocked to find the host galaxy is actually totally average. This normal heart is what grew this colossal galaxy.
